structured_output.diagnostic: Request carries three independently shippable observable outcomes rather than one; ordered as walking skeleton (correct edge/label reading against an existing index), then index materialization for fresh checkouts, then loud missing-tool degradation. Each is observable through the des code-fact driving port alone.

values.observation: In a checkout that already has graphify-out/graph.json, `des code-fact query.callers-of resolve_declared_capability --root .` answers provider: graphify, confidence: binding-resolved and lists the file:line call site of every EXTRACTED calls edge targeting the symbol, excluding imports edges; a genuinely uncalled in-root symbol answers an empty site set at binding-resolved with fault_count 0 and scope complete.

In a checkout with no graphify-out/ directory and the graphify executable on PATH, the same query materializes or refreshes the graphify index for the given root and then answers provider: graphify, confidence: binding-resolved with the real call sites, never answering provider: textsearch.
With the graphify executable absent from PATH, the query degrades LOUD: it answers provider-error naming graphify as the missing tool and never silently answers from textsearch.
